title: DMFT effective mass calculation
action: Implement DMFT for a 15-layer (100) Hubbard film (U=2W=24|t|, t=1) using exact diagonalization as the impurity solver (n_s=8 sites). For a range of fillings from 0.5 to 0.99, solve the self-consistent equations, obtain layer-dependent self-energies, and compute effective masses m_α* = 1 - dΣ_α(0)/dE. Write the surface mass, bulk mass, and mass ratio for each filling to effective_masses.csv.
description: Layer-resolved effective masses as a function of filling, with surface, bulk, and ratio columns.
output_schema: columns: n (float), m_surface (float), m_bulk (float), ratio (float); one row per filling, must include n=0.99

title: Surface mode threshold determination
action: Using the layer-dependent effective masses from step_01, evaluate the analytic criterion for a surface mode at the (0,0) and (π,π) points of the surface Brillouin zone. Determine the lowest filling n where the criterion is satisfied at each point. Write the two critical fillings to surface_mode_thresholds.csv.
description: Critical fillings at which a correlation-driven surface mode appears.
output_schema: columns: k_point (str, either '(0,0)' or '(pi,pi)'), threshold_n (float); one row per k-point
